notes:
Houston 1.4 — native macOS system monitoring, now with Sparkle updates.

- Added Check for Updates and native Updates settings: daily/weekly checks and optional automatic downloads/installation.
- Uses the public release feed; no GitHub token or account is required.
- Removed Open Activity Monitor from Performance and the bottom window status strip.
- Added an AI-usage disclosure to About Houston and source documentation.
- Preserved GPL-3.0-or-later licensing and complete upstream notices for Mission Center, graph-widget, Stats and Sparkle.

Installation: open Houston.dmg and drag Houston to Applications. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later. This development build is ad-hoc signed and is not Developer ID notarized. Sparkle updates are signed separately with Ed25519.

Corresponding source: Houston-Source.zip is included both as a release asset and inside the DMG. Supply it and the licenses when redistributing the app. Houston is GPL-3.0-or-later and provided without warranty.

AI disclosure: substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for code, design, debugging, tests, packaging and documentation. No endorsement or accuracy guarantee is implied.

Credits: [Mission Center](https://gitlab.com/mission-center-devs/mission-center), [graph-widget](https://gitlab.com/mission-center-devs/graph-widget), [Stats](https://github.com/exelban/stats), and [Sparkle](https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle). Full copyright and license notices accompany the app and source.
